sentences.text:
The present petitions have been filed under Section 397 Cr.P.C. read with Section 401 Cr.P.C.
challenging the impugned order dated 14.10.2023, whereby the charges have been framed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge (North), Rohini Courts, Delhi against the present petitioner under Sections 498A/313/406/34 IPC.

3.
He further submits that there is no entrustment, therefore, Section 406 IPC is also not attracted.
4. He submits that insofar as allegation under Section 313 IPC is concerned, there is no medical record to substantiate the allegation that the complainant was pregnant at any stage.
5. In view of the above, issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

6. Learned counsel named above, who appears on advance service, also accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.2.
7.
Let status report/reply be filed before the next date.
